recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a male country musician wearing a cowboy hat and holding an electric guitar with a paisley finish. The scene is heavily stylized with vibrant, hand-painted graffiti elements, paint drips, and splatters that merge the subject with a colorful, abstract urban backdrop.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a high-contrast, multi-colored background
Guitar pattern echoing the artist's name/identity through visual motif
Textured paint splatters bridging the foreground subject and background environment
Light source from above creating soft shadows under the hat brim

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, waist-up, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast black and white paisley guitar body at the lower center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the artist's face under the hat, moves down the guitar strap to the guitar, then follows the paint drips to the background elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with color and texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted grey and blue denim on the subject's clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red, yellow, and green in the background graffiti.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan and magenta paint splatters on the guitar and skin.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background against a medium-value, realistically lit subject.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon; use saturated primary and secondary colors with a hand-painted feel.

letterConstructionRules: Upper-left text uses heavy slab serifs with a distressed, stamped texture.
Central text uses a thin, rounded geometric sans-serif with wide tracking.
Text is integrated with graphic circles and lines.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Distressed edges on the slab serif to mimic woodblock printing.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rugged, masculine slab serif with a modern, delicate rounded sans-serif.

preserve: Distressed texture on the primary name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rugged, traditional country aesthetic of the main name.
Matches the friendly, modern, and circular nature of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man in a white cowboy hat and grey t-shirt holding a black and white paisley electric guitar. The background is a vibrant, messy graffiti wall with red, yellow, and blue blocks. Add paint splatters in cyan and magenta across the scene.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the artist name in a distressed white slab serif in the top left. Add the title in a thin, rounded white lowercase sans-serif tilted at an angle over a circular graphic on the shirt.

verificationChecks: Is the paisley pattern visible on the guitar?
Is the top-left text sufficiently distressed?
Do the paint drips look hand-applied?
Is the hat casting a soft shadow on the face?

adjustableVariables: Degree of distress on the slab serif font
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Exact brand logos on the guitar headstock

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between the two font styles
Dynamic balance between the subject and the busy background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the guitar strap is visible and textured.
Check that the paint drips overlap the subject naturally.
Verify the text is legible despite the busy background.
Confirm the color palette feels cohesive despite the high variety.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a realistic portrait of a musician with a specific instrument-related pattern (like paisley) and layer it with street-art inspired paint effects and high-contrast typographic styles.
